findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_quote, get_method · Private data: state_rules, dealer_email, desk_script · Public sink: check_quote, get_method, dealer_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_quote, get_method · Private data: state_rules, dealer_email, desk_script · Public sink: check_quote, get_method, dealer_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
